TEXT.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

S.FORM: Ynna m-eringau ki voulas tou tintin-oumi: tna-'msing-kamou ki Alid, tna-'msin-ga-appa jau-an.
S.TRANSL: Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me.
「你們心裏不要憂愁；你們信上帝，也當信我。

S.FORM: Tou talagh ki Rama-au ta madagh ki i-tou-kakouan: rou assi komma-hynna ynna-koh bannavanna ymoumi-æn: mou-koua-koh tmanang ki i-touko-ua-an ka i-toukou-ei-moumi.
S.TRANSL: In my Father's house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.
在我父的家裏有許多住處；若是沒有，我就早已告訴你們了。我去原是為你們預備地方去。

S.FORM: Irou ka d'marang-âl-ato mou-koua tmanang ymoumi-æn ki i-toukoua-an, sa-lykkoug-ah-koh mara ymoumi-æn pa-ou-koua ymoumi-æn, alei ka æ̈-i-a-koua-âl-appa-kamou ta ymoumi tou æ̈-i-a-koua-ei-mau.
S.TRANSL: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and receive you unto myself; that where I am, there ye may be also.
我若去為你們預備了地方，就必再來接你們到我那裏去，我在哪裏，叫你們也在那裏。

S.FORM: . Ka tou mang ka sahkakou'-ei-mau mavana-kamou, ka mou-mhga-kamou ki darang.
S.TRANSL: And whither I go ye know, and the way ye know.
我往哪裏去，你們知道；那條路，你們也知道。」

S.FORM: Ni-k'ma ta ti Thomas ty-ni-æn, Meirang, assi-kame mava-na tou mang ta sah-kakoua-ei-mhou: ka mou-lpough-kame ma-ma ki mang mou-mhga ki darang?
S.TRANSL: Thomas saith unto him, Lord, we know not whither thou goest; and how can we know the way?
多馬對他說：「主啊，我們不知道你往哪裏去，怎麼知道那條路呢？」

S.FORM: Ni-k'ma ta ti Jesus tyni-æn, Ti jau ta darang, ki ka-d'llig-an, ki kæuag-han-appa. Assi mou-koua ta ti mamang ki Rama-an, dijk alei jau-an.
S.TRANSL: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.
耶穌說：「我就是道路、真理、生命；若不藉着我，沒有人能到父那裏去。

S.FORM: Heirou kmalang-kamou jau-an, ynna-kamou kalang-ato ki Rama-au: ka hnyn kmalang-kamou tyni-æn, ka ni-kmytta-ka-mou tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: If ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also: and from henceforth ye know him, and have seen him.
你們若認識我，也就認識我的父。從今以後，你們認識他，並且已經看見他。」

S.FORM: Ni-k'ma ta ti Filippus ty-ni-æn, Meirang, pak'ytta-au-ka-me ki Rama, ka mamsing-al-ato-ymiæn-æn.
S.TRANSL: Philip saith unto him, Lord, shew us the Father, and it sufficeth us.
腓力對他說：「求主將父顯給我們看，我們就知足了。」

S.FORM: Ni-k'ma ta ti Jesus tyni-æn, Makka komma-hynna ki dallia ka æ̈-i-a-lam koh ymoumi-æn, ka assi-kow kmalang jau-an Filippus? Ti mamang ta ni-kmyt-ta jau-an, ni-kmytt'-appa ki Ra-ma: ka mattæ'i mang kow, pa-k'ytta-au-kame ki Rama?
S.TRANSL: Jesus saith unto him, Have I been so long time with you, and yet hast thou not known me, Philip? he that hath seen me hath seen the Father; and how sayest thou then, Shew us the Father?
耶穌對他說：「腓力，我與你們同在這樣長久，你還不認識我嗎？人看見了我，就是看見了父；你怎麼說『將父顯給我們看』呢？

S.FORM: Assi-kow kauwa tna-msing ka i-tou-koua-en nau ki Rama, ka i-tou-koua-appa ta Rama jau-an? Sou katta ka pasou-sou-en-nau ymoumi-æn, assi-koh sykkounnoung masousou, râ Ra-ma appa ka mæylli jau-an, teni ta pamut ki ryngei.
S.TRANSL: Believest thou not that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? the words that I speak unto you I speak not of myself: but the Father that dwelleth in me, he doeth the works.
我在父裏面，父在我裏面，你不信嗎？我對你們所說的話，不是憑着自己說的，乃是住在我裏面的父做他自己的事。

S.FORM: Tna-'msing-a jau-an, ka i-tou-koua koh ki Rama, ka i-tou-koua appa ta Rama jau-an, ka heirou assi, annata tna-'msing-a jau-an alei ki ryngei mamadou.
S.TRANSL: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me: or else believe me for the very works' sake.
你們當信我，我在父裏面，父在我裏面；即或不信，也當因我所做的事信我。

S.FORM: Missing, missing koun-nau-kamou-ra, ti mamang ta tna-'msing jau-an, ryngei k'anna ka pamt-ten-nau, pam't-aul-appa tyn, ka mei-saoun-al-appa ki an-na. Ka d'marang-koh mou-koua ki Rama-an:
S.TRANSL: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me, the works that I do shall he do also; and greater works than these shall he do; because I go unto my Father.
我實實在在地告訴你們，我所做的事，信我的人也要做，並且要做比這更大的事，因為我往父那裏去。

S.FORM: . Ka mamang ka t'oumi-mia-ei-moumi tou Nanang-au, pam't-au-mau k'anna: alei ka pou-vavau-eih ki kidi ta Rama tou Alak.
S.TRANSL: And whatsoever ye shall ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
你們奉我的名無論求甚麼，我必成就，叫父因兒子得榮耀。

S.FORM: Heirou tmoumimi-ah-kamou ki mamang tou Nanang-au, pam't-au-mau k'anna.
S.TRANSL: If ye shall ask any thing in my name, I will do it.
你們若奉我的名求甚麼，我必成就。」

S.FORM: Heirou mavæ'angö-ka-mou jau-an, hmaäto ki pakou-sou-en-nau.
S.TRANSL: If ye love me, keep my commandments.
「你們若愛我，就必遵守我的命令。

S.FORM: Ka tmoumimi-ah-koh ki Rama, ka pi-'æh ki Tama-Paka-haniap ka pani ymoumi-æn, alei ka mæylli-ah ymoumi-æn-tou yhkakouan myddarynnough.
S.TRANSL: And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you for ever;
我要求父，父就另外賜給你們一位保惠師，叫他永遠與你們同在，

S.FORM: Teni-an ka Joep-pan ki katiktik-an ki sou, ka assi at-ta-lpoug-in matta-ryh ki næi, alei ka assi kmytta tyni-æn, ka assi kmalang tyni-æn: râ kma-lang-kamou tyni-æn ta ymou-mi, ka mæylli ta teni ymoumi-æn, ka i-tou-koua-âl appa ymoumi-æn.
S.TRANSL: Even the Spirit of truth; whom the world cannot receive, because it seeth him not, neither knoweth him: but ye know him; for he dwelleth with you, and shall be in you.
就是真理的聖靈，乃世人不能接受的；因為不見他，也不認識他。你們卻認識他，因他常與你們同在，也要在你們裏面。

S.FORM: Assi-koh patou snæh-a' ymoumi-æn: sa-lykkough-ah-koh mou-koua ymoumi-æn.
S.TRANSL: I will not leave you comfortless: I will come to you.
我不撇下你們為孤兒，我必到你們這裏來。

S.FORM: Assi madallia ka assi kmytta-ah jau-an ta næi: râ kmyt-ta-ah-kamou jau-an ta emoumi: Alei ka mæuag-koh, ka mæuag-ah-kamou ta ymoumi.
S.TRANSL: Yet a little while, and the world seeth me no more; but ye see me: because I live, ye shall live also.
還有不多的時候，世人不再看見我，你們卻看見我；因為我活着，你們也要活着。

S.FORM: Tou wæ'i k'anna kmalang-ah-kamou, ka [i-tou-koua]-koh ki Rama, ka [i-tou-koua]-kamou jau-an, ka [i-tou-koua-app]-'oh ymou-mi-æn.
S.TRANSL: At that day ye shall know that I am in my Father, and ye in me, and I in you.
到那日，你們就知道我在父裏面，你們在我裏面，我也在你們裏面。

S.FORM: Ti-mamang ta akoumea ki pahkou-sou-en-nau, ka hmaä-appa ki anna, teni ta mavæ'angö jau-an: ka ti-mamang ta mavæ'an-gö jau-an, teni ta kavæ'ängö-eih ki Raraman-au: ka mavæ'ango-ah koh tyni-æn, ka paka-madou-ei-mau jau-an paka-æmæh tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: He that hath my commandments, and keepeth them, he it is that loveth me: and he that loveth me shall be loved of my Father, and I will love him, and will manifest myself to him.
有了我的命令又遵守的，這人就是愛我的；愛我的必蒙我父愛他，我也要愛他，並且要向他顯現。」

S.FORM: Ni-k'ma tyni-æn ta ti Ju-das,assi ti Iskariot, Meirang, ka-mang kanna, ka paka-madou-ei-mhou ymhou-an paka-æmæh y-mian-an, assi paka-æmæh ki næi?
S.TRANSL: Judas saith unto him, not Iscariot, Lord, how is it that thou wilt manifest thyself unto us, and not unto the world?
猶大（不是加略人猶大）問耶穌說：「主啊，為甚麼要向我們顯現，不向世人顯現呢？」

S.FORM: Ni mattæ'i-v'lli ta ti Je-sus k'ma tyni-æn, Ti-mamang ta mavæ'angö jau-an, hmaä-ah ki sou au: ka Rama-au ta mavæ'angö-ah tyni-æn, ka mou-koua-ah-kame tyni-æn, ka i-tou-kakou-ah-kame tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: Jesus answered and said unto him, If a man love me, he will keep my words: and my Father will love him, and we will come unto him, and make our abode with him.
耶穌回答說：「人若愛我，就必遵守我的道；我父也必愛他，並且我們要到他那裏去，與他同住。

S.FORM: Ti-mamang ta assi mavæ-'angö jau-an, assi hmaä ki sou-au. Ka sou k'atta ka 'illing'h-noumi, assi a jau, râ a tou Rama-appa, ka ni-madingi jau-an.
S.TRANSL: He that loveth me not keepeth not my sayings: and the word which ye hear is not mine, but the Father's which sent me.
不愛我的人就不遵守我的道。你們所聽見的道不是我的，乃是差我來之父的道。

S.FORM: Pa-sousou-en-ato-mau-kamou ki mamang k'atta dou mæylli-app'-oh ymoumi-an.
S.TRANSL: These things have I spoken unto you, being yet present with you.
「我還與你們同住的時候，已將這些話對你們說了。

S.FORM: Ra Tama-Paka-haniap ka Joep-pan ka d'lligh matiktik, ka padingi-eih ki Rama tou Na-nang-au, teni ta makou-atigh-ah mahkou-æmis ymoumi-æn, ka pa-hibalei-âl-appa ki mamang ka na sou-au ymoumi-æn.
S.TRANSL: But the Comforter, which is the Holy Ghost, whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring all things to your remembrance, whatsoever I have said unto you.
但保惠師，就是父因我的名所要差來的聖靈，他要將一切的事指教你們，並且要叫你們想起我對你們所說的一切話。

S.FORM: Reia ta atta-koua-en-nau ymoumi-æn, reia-au ta pæp'æ-au ymoumi-æn: assi mama ka pæ-p'æn ki næi, ta pæpæpæ̈-au k'an-na ymoumi-æn. Ynna mieringau ki voulas tou tintin-oumi, ynna mahtakout.
S.TRANSL: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.
我留下平安給你們；我將我的平安賜給你們。我所賜的，不像世人所賜的。你們心裏不要憂愁，也不要膽怯。

S.FORM: Ni-millingigh-kamou ka ni-pa-sousou-en-nau ymoumi-æn, D'marang-koh, ka sa-lykkough-ah-koh mou-koua ymou-mi-æn. Heirou-ra mavæ'angö-ato-kamou jau-an, ynna-kamou karai alei ka na sou-au, D'ma-rang-koh mou-koua ki Rama-an: ka Rama-au ta si-ourou i-tou-va-vau ki kidi jau-an.
S.TRANSL: Ye have heard how I said unto you, I go away, and come again unto you. If ye loved me, ye would rejoice, because I said, I go unto the Father: for my Father is greater than I.
你們聽見我對你們說了，我去還要到你們這裏來。你們若愛我，因我到父那裏去，就必喜樂，因為父是比我大的。

S.FORM: Ka ni-vannavanna-en-au-kamou hnyn rou assi-appa pa-væut-tin, alei ka rou pavut-ato, ka tna-msing-ah-kamou-ra.
S.TRANSL: And now I have told you before it come to pass, that, when it is come to pass, ye might believe.
現在事情還沒有成就，我預先告訴你們，叫你們到事情成就的時候就可以信。

S.FORM: Assi-koh mattæ'i-tapang-ah hnyn ki sou ymoumi-æn: alei ka ierrarouroua ta Meisasou ki næi katta, râ ä'ou-si ta teni ki ma-mang jau-an.
S.TRANSL: Hereafter I will not talk much with you: for the prince of this world cometh, and hath nothing in me.
以後我不再和你們多說話，因為這世界的王將到。他在我裏面是毫無所有；

S.FORM: Alei-appa ka mou-mhga-ah ta næi kavæ'angö-en-nau tæ Rama, ka pamut-koh kma-hyn-na mama ki ni-pahkou-sou-en ki Rama jau-an. Æhpit-tâ, d'marang-eta hia.
S.TRANSL: But that the world may know that I love the Father; and as the Father gave me commandment, even so I do. Arise, let us go hence.
但要叫世人知道我愛父，並且父怎樣吩咐我，我就怎樣行。起來，我們走吧！」
